change: Publish the reviewed static research website and its existing downloads to a dedicated public GitHub Pages repository. Keep the original Sites identity and audience. Label the local Lab entry explicitly and add a GitHub repository link.

deployment_check.scope: Initial published website. A subsequent metadata update adds this record and its links without changing the interactive code.

checks.name: Repository subpath compatibility
checks.scope: Relative static assets and downloads; hash-based navigation; no origin-root resource dependency.

checks.name: Export source parity
checks.scope: All 57 original dist files match the tested Git commit byte for byte. Git attributes prevent line-ending conversions.

checks.name: Published browser behavior
scope: Execution logic tab changes the diagram and inspector.
Recorded dashboard switches to the ferry case and shows 5 model calls, 20067 tokens, 28.41 seconds and one active card.
Case explorer renders the original failure analysis.
Studies and tests index remains accessible.

limits: GitHub Pages serves the research website, interactive visualizations and saved evidence only. Python, Ollama and agent execution are not hosted there.
Local Lab and Monitor links refer to the visitor’s computer and need local services. No local-model integration run was repeated for this hosting change.
Updates require exporting the verified dist files and pushing the publication repository. GitHub then deploys main automatically; local filesystem edits are not automatically uploaded.
The independent website repository contains already exported evidence. Rebuilding evidence requires the original project records; no research builders run in Pages CI.
This engineering validation establishes publication and UI behavior, not assistance quality. Prior frozen study results and negative findings are unchanged.
